articles.summary: Via has welcomed the Knode.ai team to enhance AI capabilities for public transit, aiming to optimize operations across cities and transit agencies.
articles.title: Via Welcomes the Knode.ai Team to Accelerate AI for Public Transit

articles.summary: Via and SMART are expanding on-demand microtransit service, SMART Flex, into northern Macomb County through a new partnership with Richmond Lenox EMS. Learn more about how this collaboration improves transit access for local communities.
articles.title: Via and SMART Expand On-Demand Microtransit Into Northern Macomb County
